topic_title: Driving is a Privilege — Risk, Responsibilities & Consequences
prompt: Under Texas administrative statutes, under what moving violation frequency may the DPS suspend a driver license for being a habitual violator?

options.text: Two or more convictions within 12 months, or four within 24 months
Six or more convictions within 12 months, or ten within 24 months
Three or more convictions within 12 months, or five within 24 months
Four or more convictions within 12 months, or seven within 24 months
